subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB2707
title: Requires the owner of a public building to periodically conduct inspections and testing of fire dampers, smoke dampers, combination fire and smoke dampers and smoke control systems in the public building.
headline: HB 2707 did not pass

claims.text: HB 2707 was introduced in the House on January 13, 2025.
HB 2707 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
